subject: Orbit 3.2: a little more room to focus
preheader: Decision threads, shared views and a calmer inbox — meet your next good workday.

content.text: Fewer interruptions. Clearer decisions. A little more space to do the work you came here for.
One quiet place for every decision.
Decision threads bring your options, context and final call together. Keep the conversation beside the work, then pin the answer so nobody has to ask twice.
Save a shared view for each team. Everyone starts with the same priorities, while personal filters keep individual to-do lists focused.

See the signal.
Skip the noise.
Choose a daily digest for activity that can wait. Mentions and requests still reach you when someone needs your attention.
Search now remembers your last filters. Long task titles have more room. And you can duplicate a recurring checklist without copying its completed items.
Your next good workday starts here.
Open your workspace and try what’s new. The Orbit team would love to hear what feels better — and what still gets in your way.
